recommendation: Keep the fixed commit as the FHIR-55483 reconciliation. No additional core source changes or related issue decisions were identified for this numberOfFrames request.
issue_request: FHIR-55483 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 Imaging Integration change request to add ImagingStudy.series.instance.numberOfFrames for the DICOM Number Of Frames (0028,0008) value on multiframe instances.
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit c429239eac28753c38f5211945b94996e2c86b05 added ImagingStudy.series.instance.numberOfFrames to the active StructureDefinition and noted it in ImagingStudy narrative, but retained a misleading short description copied from ImagingStudy.series.instance.number, used a malformed DICOM tag spelling, omitted the element from the active resource diagram, and used the non-existent plural path ImagingStudy.series.instances.numberOfFrames in the ballot note.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists imagingstudy=ImagingStudy under [resources] and assigns imagingstudy to the ii work group, so the edited ImagingStudy StructureDefinition, narrative, and diagram files are in current build scope. Jira searches found only FHIR-55483 for this numberOfFrames change, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no contrary discussion.
reconciliation: Corrected the ElementDefinition short/definition and DICOM mapping for ImagingStudy.series.instance.numberOfFrames, corrected the ballot-note element path, and added numberOfFrames to the active ImagingStudy diagram.
source_changes: source/imagingstudy/structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml: corrected the numberOfFrames short text, definition grammar, and DICOM Number Of Frames tag spelling.
source/imagingstudy/imagingstudy.svg: added the numberOfFrames row to the active ImagingStudy instance diagram.
